newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar to launch satellite channel on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to launch satellite channel on Friday.

text.p: Qatar's first satellite channel will go on air on Friday, a senior Qatari official said on Tuesday.
Al Jazeera -- Arabic word for island -- will broadcast in Arabic for almost six hours every day, said Sheikh Hamad bin Thammer al-Thani, undersecretary at the Ministry of Information and Culture.

The 20 million riyal project will be operated by Qatar Satellite Channel Corporation, a private enterprise. It will feature political, economic and sports events as well as talkshows and entertainment.
